summary.headline: Planetary Aspects and Mundane Omens
summary.text: Astrological interpretations of the Moon’s conjunction with Jupiter in Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces, and with Mars in Aries, describing outcomes by conjunction, sextile, square, trine, and opposition for scholars, rulers, soldiers, farmers, weather, prices, and public affairs.
